notes.title: (Hopefully) Release patch notes!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed how difficult it was to remove smoke once you get smokey'd[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few tooltips to explain when important things are happening (like waving mouse for smokey, and when you're running low on time!)[/p][/*][*][p]Tuned the grab logic to be more consistent and less 'slippery'[/p][/*][*][p]Added matches![/p][/*][*][p]Matches now detonate bombs if they touch, sending things flying, adding to the chaos! (Sorry!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added retry logic for the requester if the pack no longer contains the requested item (such as item falling, voiding, exploding)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch notes? How formal!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed steam achievements [/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary logging [/p][/*][*][p]added node or null checks to fix other logs [/p][/*][*][p]changed time left mechanic to actually matter at all [/p][/*][*][p]Timer highlights red when low [/p][/*][*][p]put timer reset into it's own function that now also runs when enchanting so you don't lose time on the next request [/p][/*][*][p]Lowered threshold for maid adding new items so you're less likely to get swamped [/p][/*][*][p]Made her throw 3 things instead of 5 when adding new stuff to bag[/p][/*][*][p]Also made it so the game actually ends if the timer runs out (lmao)[/p][/*][*][p]Also made it so the game won't end multiple times when the conditions for ending the game are met[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680979/a3135acf3a2c33debc910485b73a442b7be4b76b.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]
